decision.explanation: The question asks for the formation year of '94 Squadron'. The sources identify three distinct entities named '94 Squadron' formed in different years: 1) The Royal Australian Air Force (RAAF) squadron formed in 1945 (D1S6, D2S4). 2) The Royal Air Force (RAF) squadron formed in 1917 (D3S5, D5S4). 3) The US Navy Fighter Squadron 94 (VF-94) formed in 1952 (D6S4). The years 1939, 1950, and 1960 found in D4S2 represent subsequent re-formations or activations of the RAF squadron, not the initial formation of the entity itself, and thus are excluded based on the standard interpretation of 'formed' as the first establishment. The answer list preserves these three distinct valid referents.
